decisions.decision: Use distinct mosaic-migration-compiler distribution and mosaic_mmc import; MMC also names an unrelated Media Center project.
Standalone stdlib-only foundation; no copying or silently accepting the reviewed-but-unqualified CMBA successor.
Native P/PPI not bound; preserve selected real-system admission prerequisites, never invent native syntax.
T1 only supports explicit unconditional transition dependencies and constant/symbolic boolean guard lowering. Conditional/coexistence solver and live facts belong to T2/T3.
T1 derives retirement obligation placeholders but never evaluates actual fencing, drainage, legitimacy or freshness.
Semantic contract is frozen separately from runtime source fingerprint and execution evidence. No silently regenerated expected outputs.
All named arrays with set semantics normalize by ASCII identifiers; predicate operand order remains syntactic.
Candidate-freeze is an authoring decision under the user request, not independent ratification or developer licensing decision.
